description: This file defines a specialized database driver class for interacting with SQLite databases using a portable or persistent object method in PHP. It extends standard SQLite driver classes and modifies how query result fields are processed, specifically stripping table names from field names in the results.

classes.name: ADODB_sqlitepo
classes.description: A class extending the basic SQLite driver to implement a portable version with modifications for field naming conventions.

classes.name: ADORecordset_sqlitepo
classes.description: A specialized recordset class extending the SQLite recordset to modify how fetched fields are processed, mainly by stripping table prefixes from field names.

methods.name: _fetch
methods.description: Fetches query results as an array, stripping table names from the keys if present.
